stories.headline: PK Mishra applauds PM Modi’s 'visionary approach' during Gujarat earthquake and Covid-19 crisis
stories.title: PK Mishra applauds PM Modi’s 'visionary approach' during Gujarat earthquake and Covid-19 crisis
stories.summary: Speaking to reporters after addressing the inaugural day of NITI Aayog National Workshop, Mishra said that he has witnessed the then-Gujarat CM's leadership in the aftermath of the earthquake in 2001.
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: Speaking to reporters after addressing the inaugural day of NITI Aayog National Workshop, Mishra said that he has witnessed the then-Gujarat CM's leadership in the aftermath of the earthquake in 2001.

New Delhi: PK Mishra, Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister, on Tuesday, credited PM Narendra Modi's "visionary and determined" approach in "leading Gujarat out of the earthquake tragedy in 2001, during the latter's tenure as the Chief Minister, and similar leadership response during the uncertainty of the Covid-19 pandemic".
"I remember when Narendra Modi became Chief Minister for the first time, nine months after the Bhuj earthquake in Gujarat.
It was one of the biggest challenges he faced once he became the Chief Minister.
It was a very devastating earthquake: 14,000 people died, and a million houses were damaged or destroyed.
How to effectively bring about rehabilitation and reconstruction in order to meet that challenge, that, in fact, showed us his leadership qualities," he added.

According to Mishra, PM Modi doesn't believe in just announcing a scheme and giving instructions to officers, rather he likes to ensure that all the benefits reach the last mile and himself monitors it regularly.

Recalling an instance, the Principal Secretary said: "PM Modi had asked the officers who had written the rehabilitation policy of a village to visit the affected region during weekend and report to him in the weekly Monday meeting."
"After their visit, the officials said that some aspects of their policy were not appropriate and themselves suggested changes.
It is just an example of how he (Prime Minister) ensures that the changes are effective," he added.
Mishra said that several bold initiatives were taken during the Covid-19 pandemic, under PM Modi's leadership.
"During that time, nobody knew what effects the pandemic will have, even in other countries.

stories.headline: Andhra Pradesh prepares for severe Cyclone Akvan hitting coast this November
stories.title: Andhra Pradesh prepares for severe Cyclone Akvan hitting coast this November
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh prepares for severe Cyclone Akvan hitting coast this November
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: Amaravati: The cyclonic storm named Akvan forming over parts of Bay of Bengal is expected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm later in the day, the Meteorological Department said on Tuesday.
Under the influence of the cyclone, heavy rainfall is forecast in parts of Andhra Pradesh.
Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to ensure that the impact of the cyclone does not fall on people.

The southern state was battered by two cyclones in quick succession recently -- Arnab and Murasu -- flattening lakhs of acres of crops and causing a loss estimated at nearly Rs 7,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh.
"Continuously keep sending weather alerts to people and cyclone-affected regions.
Swarna Gram and Swarna Ward personnel should directly disseminate information in cyclone-affected regions," the CM said in an official release.
Uprooted tree debris and damaged electric poles should be cleared immediately, he said, adding that precautions should be taken so that people avoid breaches, ponds and canals.

Cyclone Akvan, located over central parts of the south and adjoining West-Central Bay of Bengal, moved slowly north to northwestwards at a speed of 3 kmph during the past six hours and lay centred at 8.30 am today over the same region, the Met department said.

"The cyclonic storm Akvan is very likely to move slowly north-northwestwards and intensify further into a severe cyclonic storm over west central Bay of Bengal around this evening (Tuesday)," the Met Department said in an official release.

Currently, the weather system is located about 610 km east of Chennai, 630 km northeast of Trincomalee, 660 km southeast of Machilipatnam, 670 km south to southeast of Visakhapatnam and 790 km south of Gopalpur.
It is likely to move northwestwards and intensify further into a very severe cyclonic storm around November 19 morning.

Continuing to move northwestwards, it is likely to cross Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Tuni around noon on November 20 as a very severe cyclonic storm with a maximum sustained wind speed of up to 145 kmph.

stories.headline: AP CM Naidu meets FM Sitharaman, seeks funds for cyclone relief
stories.title: AP CM Naidu meets FM Sitharaman, seeks funds for cyclone relief
stories.summary: The Chief Minister explained the extensive damage caused by Cyclones Arnav and Murasu, which recently hit the state
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu appealed to Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to provide immediate financial assistance to the State, which has suffered extensive damage across several sectors, including agriculture, due to two consecutive cyclones.
Naidu met the Union Finance Minister in New Delhi on Tuesday and informed her of the financial situation of the State government, damage caused by the recent cyclones.
The Chief Minister explained the extensive damage caused by Cyclones Arnav and Murasu, which recently hit the state.
According to preliminary estimates, the two cyclones together caused losses exceeding ₹7,000 crore.
He briefed the Union Finance Minister on the precautionary measures taken by the State government ahead of the cyclones and the subsequent relief and restoration efforts.

Despite the impact of El Niño, the State government had ensured irrigation water supply to several areas through the Pattiseema project to support farmers who were, however, hit by the cyclones, he said, and appealed to the Union Finance Minister to extend immediate financial assistance.

The Chief Minister also apprised Sitaraman of the Rayalaseema Horticulture Hub, release of Purvodaya funds and region-specific development plans of the State government and the `success’ of the Visakhapatnam CII Partnership Summit, according to a release.

stories.headline: Lowest of 11.2°C in Telangana’s Sangareddy; cyclone Akvan may change weather conditions from November 19
stories.title: Lowest of 11.2°C in Telangana’s Sangareddy; cyclone Akvan may change weather conditions from November 19
stories.summary: Sangareddy in Telangana recorded the state’s coldest temperature at 11.2°C on Monday night into Tuesday, with nearby districts also hovering around the low teens, as a chilly spell continues amid forecasts of rain.
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: The lowest temperature in Telangana dipped marginally in a day.
From 11.7°C, it dropped to 11.2°C between the mornings on Monday and Tuesday (November 17, 2026).
The weather was chillier in the same period last year as the lowest temperature then was 7.1°C.

The lowest of 11.2°C in Sangareddy (Kohir) was followed by 11.3°C in Rangareddy (Shabad); 11.7°C in Kamareddy (Gandhari), 11.8°C in Vikarabad (Bantwaram) and 12.0 in Mahabubnagar (Rajapur), as per Telangana Development Planning Society’s latest weather report.
In urban parts of the State, the 11.3°C in Rangareddy was followed by 13.4°C in Medchal Malkajgiri (Uppal) and 15.0°C in Hyderabad (Golconda).
The cold temperatures may be accompanied by rains in a few districts of the State under the impact of cyclonic storm Akvan.

India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre has forecast thunderstorms accompanied with lightening with gusty winds were forecast as very likely at isolated places in Jayashankar Bhupalapally, Mulugu, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam, Nalgonda, Mahabubabad, Warangal and Hanumakonda districts on Thursday (November 19, 2026).

The weather situation may take a turn on Friday (November 20, 2026) as heavy to very heavy rains along with thunderstorms and lightening were predicted in isolated parts of Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam, Mahabubabad and Suryapet.

stories.title: Nvidia sets up national security committee after Jensen Huang's abrupt departure
stories.summary: The new board committee will oversee export control compliance and national security policies

article_sentences: Nvidia is setting up a new board committee to oversee national security and global trade compliance following revelations about former CEO Jensen Huang's alleged extramarital affair with a Chinese businesswoman suspected of links to the diversion of advanced chips to China.
The company's National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee will be responsible for overseeing national security policies and compliance with export controls, Nvidia said on Tuesday.
Nvidia's advanced chips are in high demand because they are essential for cloud computing and data centres that underpin the artificial intelligence boom.
However, their sale to China is subject to US export restrictions.
The committee will comprise three members of Nvidia's board of directors and meet at least once every quarter.
It will work with independent third-party experts to oversee efforts to strengthen the company's existing national security and global trade compliance team.

"We are committed to working constructively with government and industry partners to help establish and advance a robust framework that uses every tool at our disposal to safeguard national security while supporting continued technological innovation," chairman Harvey Jones said in a statement.
US President Donald Trump welcomed the move, calling it a good idea shortly after arriving in the Philippines on Tuesday evening.
"Yes, that's a good idea.
It's a great company," Trump said during a photo opportunity in Manila with the leaders of Australia, India and Japan.
"It's a great idea."

Huang was forced to resign as Nvidia's CEO last week following scrutiny of his relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who previously led Singapore-based cloud computing company Megaspeed International.

stories.title: Nvidia sets up board committee to oversee national security, export control risks amid China scrutiny
stories.summary: Nvidia's board of directors has constituted a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee as a standing committee, according to a statement.
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence

event term: 'national security' in summary weight 42
article_sentences: Nvidia is strengthening trade compliance and geopolitical risk management through a dedicated board committee, following export restrictions and leadership controversy tied to its China operations.
Discover how the chipmaker plans to balance tightening trade controls with surging global demand.

Nvidia has established a new board-level committee to oversee its national security policies, export control compliance and global trade risk management, amid heightened scrutiny of the artificial intelligence (AI) chipmaker's business dealings and potential risks linked to its China operations.
The company's board of directors has constituted a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee as a standing committee, according to a statement.
Director Suzanne Nora Johnson has been appointed chair of the committee, while Stephen C. Neal and John O. Dabiri have been named as its other members.
Nvidia's National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team will report directly to the new committee.
It will meet at least once every quarter, including with company management and in executive sessions.
The committee will also be able to retain independent external experts in law, national security and trade compliance.

The development comes days after former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's departure following controversy over his relationship with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed International, which has faced scrutiny over suspected violations of US export controls.
Huang admitted to an extramarital relationship in a message to Nvidia employees on November 8 and apologised to his family and colleagues.
The admission followed reports about his relationship with Alice Huang, whom US officials have reportedly suspected of having links to Chinese intelligence.
The allegations have not been independently established, and China has rejected claims of espionage.

stories.headline: Delhi building collapse: Two killed, five injured as 50-year-old Jwala Nagar structure gives way
stories.title: Delhi building collapse: Two killed, five injured as 50-year-old Jwala Nagar structure gives way
stories.summary: The three-year-old boy and a factory worker were among those killed; residents allege repeated complaints about the building’s deteriorating condition went unaddressed, while MCD flags possible role of railway vibrations
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'building collapse' in title weight 46
article_sentences: Two people, including a three-year-old boy, were killed and five others injured after a nearly 50-year-old building, housing a gajak factory on the ground floor and residential rooms above it, collapsed in east Delhi’s Jwala Nagar on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) morning, trapping people under the debris.
The owner of the property, identified as Surendar Singh, was subsequently arrested, after he switched off his mobile phone and tried to flee, DCP (Shahdara) R.P. Meena said.

An FIR has been registered under Sections 106(1) (Causing death by negligence), 125(A) (Causing hurt by a rash or negligent act endangering life or safety) and 223 (Disobedience to an order duly promulgated by a public servant) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).
Mr. Meena said Section 223 was added to the FIR as the owner did not verify the tenants staying in his property.
The collapse, which brought down the right portion of the building in a congested residential lane, left a heap of bricks, iron girders and household belongings where the structure had stood.

Residents said they had repeatedly raised concerns about the building’s deteriorating condition, pointing to leaking roof, cracks in its walls and metal girders and other structural elements becoming exposed, but alleged that the owner had not undertaken the necessary repairs.
The deceased were identified as Devansh alias Laddu (3), and Pintu (32).
The injured were identified as Devansh’s mother Khushbu (30), Vikesh (30), Akash (27), Dalip (26), Aman alias Dosa (32).
All six were taken to Dr. Hedgewar Hospital, where Devansh and Pintu were declared brought dead, while the injured were admitted for treatment.
The incident was reported around 10.09 a.m. in Gali No. 6, near Peer Baba Mazar in the Sabji Mandi area.
A distress call was received at Vivek Vihar police station, following which police personnel rushed to the spot and initiated rescue operations.
The Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), meanwhile, recorded receiving the incident call at 10.25 a.m.

stories.title: SC seeks EC's response to 48 questions by INDIA bloc leaders before 9 Dec
stories.summary: A SC headed by the Chief Justice of India on Tuesday, 17 November, sought a response from the EC to the 48 questions on SIR
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence

article_sentences: - On 15 October, the Supreme Court issued notice to the Election Commission on the petition filed by several INDIA bloc leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, on SIR.
The ECI has filed two affidavits in response.
In a fresh application, the INDIA bloc leaders have sought the court’s permission under the Supreme Court Rules to serve an interrogatory comprising 48 questions on the ECI.

- An ‘interrogatory’ is an application seeking written replies from the opposite party to questions raised to determine the dispute, in this case relating to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
- The ‘interrogatory’, the application states, is necessary because the ECI has failed to address the questions in its two affidavits.

“When facts central to the constitutional challenge are known exclusively by an authority administering a system, the court may require officials to answer specific questions,” the Supreme Court had ruled in Puttaswamy vs Union of India.

The application filed by INDIA bloc leaders relied on this precedent and three provisions of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013, to seek permission to serve the interrogatory comprising 48 questions on SIR.
An interrogatory is a judicial procedure requiring answers on affidavit to written questions.
The answers become part of the evidence.

The leaders pleaded in the application that the questions had become necessary because the Election Commission's affidavits make assertions about unanimous decisions and approvals but do not disclose the underlying records, file notings, dates or minutes needed to verify those assertions.
The court may allow, modify or reject the request.

On 17 November, the Bench comprising CJI Justice Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice V Mohana indicated that it would first consider the Election Commission’s response and any objections before deciding on the request.

stories.headline: Reel Makers Not Entitled To Journalistic Protection During Protests, Delhi Police To Supreme Court
stories.title: Reel Makers Not Entitled To Journalistic Protection During Protests, Delhi Police To Supreme Court
stories.summary: It has to be determined if reel-makers and content-creators can be elevated to the status of journalists, the Delhi police said.
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'supreme court' in title weight 44
article_sentences: It has to be determined if reel-makers and content-creators can be elevated to the status of journalists, the Delhi police said.

The Delhi Police has told the Supreme Court that its order directing protection of journalists covering the anti-Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) protests was not intended to cover "so-called reel makers and social media influencers".
In a counter-affidavit filed before the Supreme Court, the Delhi.

Police said that some participants in the "illegal protests" were content creators making YouTube reels while carrying cameras and microphones, making it difficult for police personnel to distinguish between genuine journalists and reel-makers on the ground.

The police said that it had to be determined whether "reel-makers can be elevated to the status of journalists or reporters", adding that the distinction was highlighted only to explain the practical difficulties faced by police personnel while managing protests.
Clarifying that it did not intend to obstruct content creators from pursuing their activities, the Delhi.

Police said that the guidelines for journalists covering protests were meant to distinguish professional journalists and reporters from persons carrying cameras and microphones for other purposes, including commercial exploitation of content.
The affidavit was filed by Joint Commissioner of Police Surrender Kumar on behalf of the Delhi.

Police responding to the petitions filed by the Network of Women in Media, Free Speech Collective, Delhi Union of Journalists and the Kerala Union of Working Journalists concerning alleged police misconduct against journalists covering the protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

The police referred to the Supreme Court's order dated October 11, 2026, which recorded the assurance given by the Solicitor General that lawyers, journalists and other professionals would not be hindered in discharging their professional duties.

It submitted that the direction was intended to protect journalists in the discharge of their professional duties and was not meant to exempt reel-makers, social media influencers or unruly elements from the general law or lawful directions of law enforcement agencies at the site of a prohibited assembly.

The affidavit further stated that the police had not placed any restriction on the right of citizens to report or disseminate information, nor had anyone been proceeded against merely for lacking press accreditation or an identity card.

stories.headline: Supreme Court Upholds Introduction Of Written Exam Midway Through Recruitment, Says It Ensures Objective Assessment
stories.title: Supreme Court Upholds Introduction Of Written Exam Midway Through Recruitment, Says It Ensures Objective Assessment
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'supreme court' in title weight 44
article_sentences: The Supreme Court has upheld the introduction of a written examination midway through the recruitment process for 46 Excise Constable posts in Nagaland, observing that an objective written test provides a common basis for assessing candidates and avoids placing disproportionate reliance on the comparatively subjective assessment involved in a viva-voce.

A Bench of Justice Prashant Kumar Mishra and Justice Shree Chandrashekhar held that the recruitment rules permitted selection through a competitive examination and that the written examination, based on the prescribed Class VIII syllabus, fell within the scope of that provision.
It further observed that the petitioners could not show how they suffered any prejudice by taking part in the revised procedure.
However, through a corrigendum dated June 4, 2025, the Departmental Recruitment Board introduced a written examination.
The examination, carrying 100 marks, was based on the Class VIII syllabus.
The State, on the other hand, submitted that it had received 11,521 applications for 46 posts.
Of the 5,985 candidates who appeared for the physical test, 2,297 qualified for the next stage.
It argued that an objective written examination was necessary to shortlist candidates fairly.

Rejecting the challenge, the judgment authored by Justice Mishra held that the Nagaland Excise Service (Revised) Rules, 1999, permitted direct recruitment through a “competitive examination/selection” and did not prescribe a detailed procedure for conducting the selection.
Thus, the introduction of the written exam in the middle of the recruitment drive would not make the recruitment exercise vitiated.
As a result, the appeal was dismissed.
For Respondent(s):Mr. K N Balgopal Advocate General Of The State Of Nagaland, Sr. Adv.

stories.headline: Supreme Court Applies Doctrine Of Indoor Management, Says Company's Boardroom Dispute Cannot Invalidate Sale To Bona Fide Third-Party
stories.title: Supreme Court Applies Doctrine Of Indoor Management, Says Company's Boardroom Dispute Cannot Invalidate Sale To Bona Fide Third-Party
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'supreme court' in title weight 44
article_sentences: The Supreme Court has observed that a third-party purchaser of a company's asset relying on a Company's Board Resolution meeting to undertake the purchase is protected under the Transfer of Property Act, and the sale cannot be invalidated merely because there's an internal dispute regarding the authority to execute the sale deed.

According to the Court, the unrelated third party cannot be expected to verify the internal affairs of the company, particularly whether the Board meeting authorising the transaction was validly convened.

A bench of Justice Sanjay Kumar and Justice Sanjeev Sachdeva set aside the concurrent findings of NCLAT and NCLT, which had ruled against the unrelated third party, i.e., the Appellant-M/s Elaine Info Solutions Pvt.

Ltd., on the pretext that the Appellant was not able to establish that another Director of the Respondent company participated in the board meeting, in which the resolution to sell the company's asset was passed.

Noting that the Appellant is an unrelated third party to the Respondent's internal affairs and cannot be expected to know about the company's meeting and passing of the resolution, hence, a sale deed executed pursuant to the Respondent's board resolution cannot be cancelled merely because the Appellant failed to prove the participation of another director in the meeting.
“The Doctrine of Indoor Management would clearly come to apply in the present case.
Both NCLT and NCLAT have primarily acted by holding that the resolution of the Board of Directors had not been passed and the sale deed executed based thereon was invalid.
Appellant, being an unrelated third-party would have no knowledge of the indoor affairs of the Company… It may be noted that the Appellant is a third-party to the affairs of the Company.
The Board Resolution dated 01.08.2015 is alleged to have been passed in a meeting held on the same date 01.08.2015.

Though the sale deed dated 04.09.2015 refers to a resolution of the Board Meeting dated 01.08.2015, Appellant cannot be attributed to have any knowledge of the same as the holding of the meeting and passing of the said resolution would be within the personal knowledge of the Directors/shareholders of the Company.”, the Court observed.
The case arose from a dispute within Respondent company-M/s J & A Avenues India Private Limited, whose shares were equally held by a mother and her son, both of whom were also directors.

The mother had approached the NCLT under Section 241 of the Companies Act, 2013, alleging that her son had transferred 9 acres and 28 guntas of the company's land to the Appellant, Elaine Info Solutions Pvt.

stories.headline: ONGC stops gas leak from Tatipaka well in Konaseema district
stories.title: ONGC stops gas leak from Tatipaka well in Konaseema district
stories.summary: The gas leakage, which was reported early morning on November 17, 2026, was controlled at around late afternoon on the same day following sustained well-control operations
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'gas leak' in title weight 42
article_sentences: State-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) said on Tuesday that it has successfully controlled the gas leak from its Tatipaka well in Geddada Village of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema District in Andhra Pradesh.
no injuries or casualties have been reported in connection with the incident.
The gas leakage, which was reported early morning on November 17, 2026, was controlled at around late afternoon on the same day following sustained well-control operations.
The incident occurred during workover operations.
Following the successful control of gas flow, ONGC continues to maintain a vigilant watch over the situation, with all necessary safety and monitoring measures.

Upon completion of further observations and assessment of site conditions, ONGC has duly informed the district administration regarding withdrawal of the precautionary cordon and all other restrictions.
Upon receiving information, ONGC’s Rajahmundry Asset promptly activated the disaster management team.
The Emergency Response Team rushed to the site and initiated appropriate safety and well-control measures, the company said.
The Disaster Management Plan was activated, and additional personnel, equipment and resources were mobilised from the Regional Crisis Management facilities at Narsapur, it added.
ONGC remains committed to maintaining the highest standards of operational safety and safeguarding the well-being of its personnel and the surrounding community.

Speaking to ANI on the sidelines of the JRD TATA Awards 2026, Dev expressed confidence in the country's economic outlook, citing sustained export momentum, diversification of export markets and improving foreign investment inflows as key contributors to growth.
